domains.target: Cloudflare Pages app shell backed by Railway hub API
Cloudflare Pages status shell backed by Railway API
Railway heiwa-core service behind Cloudflare proxy/WAF

bootstrap_steps: Point heiwa.ltd at the Cloudflare Pages marketing project.
Point app.heiwa.ltd at the Cloudflare Pages authenticated app shell.
Point status.heiwa.ltd at the Cloudflare Pages status shell.
Point docs.heiwa.ltd at the Cloudflare Pages docs project built from MkDocs Material.
Attach api.heiwa.ltd to the Railway heiwa-core service and enforce Cloudflare proxy/WAF.
Keep SpacetimeDB external on maincloud.spacetimedb.com rather than modeling it as a Railway service or volume.
Keep internal preview runtimes such as heiwa-trading off the supported public host manifest until they graduate into first-class product surfaces.
Enable strict TLS and baseline WAF rules for api.heiwa.ltd while keeping app.heiwa.ltd and the other Pages shells behind Cloudflare edge controls.
Run post-cutover checks for api.heiwa.ltd/health, status.heiwa.ltd, app.heiwa.ltd, and public page endpoints.
